$comment: Component implementation contract (P14). Each library file lists the tokens/classes its implementation MUST keep, so a regression to hardcoded values (h-8, shadow-md, missing padding) fails validate_package instead of surfacing in production. Add an entry whenever a calibration lesson changes a component's mechanism.

library/shadcn/ui/button.tsx.why: control height and pill radius are theme tokens (quiet-inset 0.6.x calibration); hardcoded h-8 / rounded-lg regresses the reference; focus-visible uses 2px outline so keyboard focus stays visible on primary/destructive fills

library/shadcn/ui/select.tsx.why: control height, control radius, menu inset (p-1) so the selected row never touches the menu edge, floating shadow via shadow-lg

library/shadcn/ui/switch.tsx.why: 30x20 switch size is a theme token

library/shadcn/ui/sheet.tsx.why: the sheet container owns the inset (same contract as Dialog); content blocks carry no padding, so dropping the p-4 puts bordered panels against the drawer edge

library/shadcn/ui/dialog.tsx.why: dialog header clears the close button (pr-8) and content grid children shrink cleanly (min-w-0)

library/shadcn/ui/sidebar.tsx.why: 28/30px rows, secondary item gray, 500 weight, hover/selected step, menu-active tokens and optional indicator bar

library/blocks/page-header.tsx.why: icon-only actions per the icon principle; inline budget (default 2) and the destructive-never-inline filter are the header contract

library/blocks/surfaces.tsx.why: NavItem keeps the sidebar row height token, depth indentation, menu-active tokens and trailing slot; Split keeps full-height grid rows, sidePosition=end ordering and fixed sideHeader above the overlay scroll region; NavList keeps 2px rhythm; ScrollRegion keeps 0px overlay scrollbar

library/blocks/list-detail.tsx.why: PaneHeader sits outside the pane ScrollRegion so its rule spans flush to the divider and the scrollbar starts below it

library/blocks/markdown.tsx.why: links use hover color, not underlines

library/blocks/use-container-width.ts.why: the observer must re-attach when the node mounts late (behind a loading branch); an empty-deps effect observes null once and the width stays 0
